q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: SELECT DISTINCT SALESPERSON.NAME FROM ORDERS INNER JOIN COMPANY ON (ORDERS.COM_ID = COMPANY.COM_ID AND COMPANY.NAME = 'RED') RIGHT JOIN SALESPERSON ON SALESPERSON.SALES_ID = ORDERS.SALES_ID WHERE ORDERS.SALES_ID IS NULL
